title: RunRecord
description: The full persisted record of one validation run -- what the report page renders, what gets written to the audit sheet, and what the eval harness compares expected vs actual against.

evidence_bundle.description: Raw collector output -- CI status, coverage, code scanning alerts, dependabot alerts, changed files. Kept for audit/replay; not re-validated by this schema, see fixtures/github/ for shape examples.

gates.description: Non-empty means the band computed from the score is overridden -- see scoring/scorer.js applyGates().

capped.description: true if this deduction was reduced by a category cap

correlations.description: Findings sharing a file, e.g. a regression and a reachable CVE in the same file -- 'same blast radius'.

decision.description: band as adjusted by gates -- this is the authoritative outcome shown in the report, NOT `band` alone.

summary.description: LLM-written narrative, must only restate numbers present in findings/deductions/score.

outcome.description: PRD 6.3 feedback loop -- filled in later, manually or via the one follow-up Slack ping.
